intro.text: Empty Data Receptacle Containers can be found on RK team mission bosses and dyna's.
A Fixer can fill it and the owner of the container can use it to enter the Fixer Grid

steps.text: Note: by right clicking the full container it will revert to an empty container and also spawn:
Click the Data Receptacle on a Grid Terminal and you will be granted access to the Fixer Grid.
